description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and the Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning methods of the Whisper model, specifically for the "tiny" type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, and tick labels at every 10 units. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: tiny AdaLoRA int4 (dark gray, circle markers, solid line), tiny (medium gray, square markers, solid line), tiny int4 (light gray, circle markers, dashed line), tiny int8 (medium gray, square markers, dashed line), and tiny full (light gray, triangle markers, dotted line). The tiny AdaLoRA int4 line starts at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 33 at epoch 6. The tiny line begins at about 59 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 34 at epoch 6. The tiny int4 line starts at around 65 at epoch 0 and decreases to about 37 at epoch 6. The tiny int8 line begins at approximately 50 at epoch 0, remains steady until epoch 2, and then decreases to around 36 at epoch 6. The tiny full line starts at about 30 at epoch 0 and remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 26 at epoch 6. All lines exhibit a general downward trend across the epochs, with varying rates of decrease.
